title: Kelp: A Streaming Safeguard for Large Models via Latent Dynamics-Guided Risk Detection
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not specifically measure any aspects of faith or religion. Its safety benchmark, StreamGuardBench, uses broad categories like 'Hate Speech' and 'Bias' which could potentially include religious content, but religion is not an explicit category of analysis.
findings: The paper does not analyze or report any findings related to religion.
